# How many pieces a month does your dry cleaner need to break even, and what price rise would fix a loss?

> Free dry cleaner profit calculator: pieces, price, supplies, claims, card fees, labor and rent become monthly profit, break-even pieces, the price increase that covers your costs and debt coverage. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
